title: Wonderful experience full of magic.
text: We can say, with all our hearts, that it has been the most impressive guided tour we have ever done in our lives. It was the first time we were visiting the Alhambra, and fortune smiled upon us when we saw that for those 3 hours, we were the only ones who were going to be with our guide: Eva. She showed us every corner, made us live the experience as if we had traveled back in time, and wrapped every corner in her magic and wisdom. It felt so short because we had such a good time... I don't think we could have chosen better; we will carry that trip in our memories for the rest of our lives 💖 T
author: andreaoD5283RJ

title: Happiness

title: Historical visit with close and individualized treatment. Great option for humans with dog.
text:
It was a great experience, 

We visited the Alhambra as a couple accompanied by Eva who took us through its entire history, in a very didactic and entertaining way, providing historical gossip ☺️.

As we travel with our dog, we greatly appreciate her special treatment towards her as she was taken care of at all times and enjoying the gardens while we make the visit.

100% recommended!!
